Run the complete operating model

Source: R/io.R
om_run.Rd

Simulates the biomass truth, the fishery and the scenario data sets in one call and, if dir is given, writes every output with the folder structure of Experimento 02 (dir/Simulacao_Biomassa/outputs/... and dir/Simulacao_Pesca/outputs/...).

Usage

om_run(
  preset = "BET_ICCAT",
  biomass_cfg = om_biomass_config(preset),
  fishery_cfg = om_fishery_config(preset),
  domain = NULL,
  scenarios = TRUE,
  dir = NULL,
  figures = TRUE,
  csv = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

preset

Preset used for the default configurations.

biomass_cfg, fishery_cfg

Configurations (default: the preset).

domain

Optional spatial domain (see simulate_biomass()).

scenarios

Generate the scenario data sets.

dir

Output folder (NULL: nothing is written).

figures, csv

Write figures / csv copies when dir is given.

verbose

Print progress.

Value

A list of class om_run with biomass, fishery and scenarios.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
run <- om_run("BET_ICCAT", dir = "Experimento_pelagicOM")
run$scenarios
} # }
